basic_info.description: Classic ENGLISH STYLE tunnel-entrance residence features over 2200 sq. ft of interior living space and a SUPERB Sunset District location. Super easy walking distance to Noriega Street shops, eateries, and only minutes to Ocean Beach and iconic Golden Gate Park. This great home was expanded to include  two connected levels of living space over a very deep lot. The upper main level features three bedrooms and two baths, including a large primary suite. The light-filled living room has parquet wood floors, period crown molding, and a corner fireplace with beautiful decorative surround. The formal dining room flows into a bright kitchen with skylight, generous cabinetry, and tiled counter space. The lower GARDEN level boasts a nice sized bedroom, two full baths, and MULTI-USE bonus rooms. The terraced rear yard features VINTAGE cobblestone walls and mature trees. The garage includes 1-car parking, storage, and laundry hookups. This is a MUST-SEE home! COME SEE QUICK!!!
